items.kind: even though instead of even so
items.pattern: even though/even if standing alone after a semicolon
items.sk: „Even though/if“ uvádza vedľajšiu vetu; samostatne patrí „{right}“.
items.cz: „Even though/if“ uvádí vedlejší větu; samostatně patří „{right}“.
items.en: “even though/if” starts a clause; on its own use “{right}”.

items.pattern: although standing alone after a semicolon/full stop
items.en: “although” cannot stand alone; use “{right}”.

items.pattern: although at the end of a sentence
items.sk: Na konci vety môže stáť len „though“, nie „although“.
items.cz: Na konci věty může stát jen „though“, ne „although“.
items.en: Only “though” can end a sentence, not “although”.

items.pattern: although … , but … (calque of 'hoci …, ale')
items.sk: Pri „although“ sa „but“ nepíše; stačí jedno z nich.
items.cz: U „although“ se „but“ nepíše; stačí jedno z nich.
items.en: Do not use “but” with “although”; one is enough.

items.pattern: despite of + noun
items.sk: „Despite“ je bez „of“; s „of“ je len „in spite of“.
items.cz: „Despite“ je bez „of“; s „of“ je jen „in spite of“.
items.en: “despite” has no “of”; only “in spite of” does.

items.pattern: in spite + noun
items.en: “in spite” needs “of”: “in spite of”.

items.pattern: although/even though + noun phrase without a verb
items.sk: Po „although“ nasleduje veta so slovesom; pred podstatným menom patrí „{right}“.
items.cz: Po „although“ následuje věta se slovesem; před podstatným jménem patří „{right}“.
items.en: “although” needs a clause with a verb; before a noun use “{right}”.

items.pattern: despite/in spite of + full clause with a verb
items.sk: Po „despite“ nemôže nasledovať veta so slovesom: „{right}“.
items.cz: Po „despite“ nemůže následovat věta se slovesem: „{right}“.
items.en: “despite” cannot be followed by a clause with a verb: “{right}”.

items.pattern: despite/in spite of standing alone as a sentence linker
items.en: “despite” needs a noun; on its own use “{right}”.

items.pattern: although + clause instead of the practised despite + noun
items.en: Practise “{right}” with a noun here.

items.pattern: however instead of even so / nevertheless
items.sk: „However“ vyjadrí len kontrast; „napriek tomu“ presnejšie vystihuje „{right}“.
items.en: “however” only shows contrast; “{right}” fits the meaning better.

items.pattern: simple but instead of the practised linker
items.en: Practise “{right}” here instead of “but”.

items.pattern: still/yet as the linker instead of the practised one
items.en: Practise “{right}” here.

items.pattern: even without so for 'aj tak'
items.en: “even” alone means something else; the linker is “{right}”.

items.pattern: so (result) instead of a contrast linker
items.en: “so” shows a result, not contrast: “{right}”.

items.pattern: therefore/thus instead of a contrast linker
items.en: “therefore” shows a result, not contrast: “{right}”.

items.pattern: moreover/furthermore instead of a contrast linker
items.en: “moreover” adds information; it shows no contrast: “{right}”.

items.pattern: because of instead of despite
items.en: “because of” is a cause, not a contrast: “{right}”.

items.pattern: on the contrary for simple contrast between two facts
items.sk: „On the contrary“ popiera predošlé tvrdenie; tu patrí „{right}“.
items.cz: „On the contrary“ popírá předchozí tvrzení; tady patří „{right}“.
items.en: “on the contrary” denies what came before; use “{right}”.

items.pattern: otherwise for 'aj tak/napriek tomu'
items.en: “otherwise” means “or else”; use “{right}”.

items.pattern: active -ing instead of past participle after feel/seem (felt watching)
items.sk: Tvar s -ing je činný; pocit, že sa to deje podmetu, je „{right}“.
items.cz: Tvar s -ing je činný; pocit, že se to děje podmětu, je „{right}“.
items.en: The -ing form is active; being on the receiving end is “{right}”.
